issues.problem: The outbox drain takes a SESSION-level lock (pg_try_advisory_lock / pg_advisory_unlock on a dedicated client). The app connects through the Supabase transaction pooler (DATABASE_URL port 6543, verified in .env). On that pooler a session lock sticks to whichever shared backend ran it and the unlock can land on a different one, so the lock either leaks forever (no drain ever runs again, every save sits waiting) or does not exclude a second drain (two commits of the same rows). The repo already learned this with SET (memory: pooler-session-set-leaks); its only advisory lock is transaction-scoped (src/finance/soft-pulls.mjs:560).

The GitHub phase then works only on rows carrying this claim_id, with no lock held. Reclaim = the 10-minute predicate. Change the pg test from 'two concurrent drains make one commit (advisory lock)' to 'two concurrent claims get disjoint rows and the second returns busy'.
